# Start French Now

> Start French Now is a bilingual French-learning website focused on online preparation for the Swiss FIDE test and structured French courses for adult learners. The official canonical domain is https://startfrenchnow.ch.

## Swiss FIDE test — French

- [Guide complet du test FIDE](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fr/fide): Présentation du test FIDE en Suisse, des niveaux A1 à B1, des compétences évaluées et des solutions de préparation.
- [Pack Exam FIDE](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fr/fide/pack-fide): Parcours e-learning consacré à la préparation du test FIDE.
- [Examens blancs FIDE](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fr/fide/mock-exams): Examens d'entraînement en ligne pour se familiariser avec les épreuves.
- [Cours privés FIDE](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fr/fide/private-courses): Accompagnement individuel en ligne adapté au niveau et à l'objectif de l'apprenant.
- [Vidéos sur le test FIDE](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fr/fide/videos): Ressources vidéo consacrées aux différentes épreuves.

## Swiss FIDE test — English

- [Swiss FIDE test guide](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fide): Overview of the Swiss FIDE test, A1 to B1 levels, assessed skills, and preparation options.
- [FIDE Exam Pack](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fide/pack-fide): Self-paced e-learning pathway for FIDE test preparation.
- [FIDE mock exams](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fide/mock-exams): Online practice exams designed to familiarize learners with the test.
- [Private FIDE lessons](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fide/private-courses): Individual online support based on the learner's level and objective.
- [FIDE test videos](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fide/videos): Video resources covering the different test sections.

## French courses and learning resources

- [Beginner French courses](https://startfrenchnow.ch/courses/beginners): Structured French courses for complete beginners.
- [Intermediate French courses](https://startfrenchnow.ch/courses/intermediates): Courses for learners progressing beyond the beginner level.
- [Daily-life dialogues](https://startfrenchnow.ch/courses/dialogues): French practice through everyday dialogues.
- [French learning blog](https://startfrenchnow.ch/blog): Articles about French learning and the FIDE test.
- [French exercises](https://startfrenchnow.ch/exercises): Online practice activities.
- [Interactive stories](https://startfrenchnow.ch/stories): French practice through interactive stories.
- [French videos](https://startfrenchnow.ch/videos): Educational videos for French learners.

## About and contact

- [About Yohann Coussot](https://startfrenchnow.ch/about): Professional background and personal story of the French teacher behind Start French Now.
- [À propos de Yohann Coussot](https://startfrenchnow.ch/fr/about): Parcours professionnel et présentation personnelle du professeur de français derrière Start French Now.
- [Contact](https://startfrenchnow.ch/contact): Contact page for course and FIDE preparation questions.
